name: 22044 · Falls Church, VA
findings: ZIP 22044 (Falls Church) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22044 (Falls Church) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22044 (Falls Church) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
